
[[File:酉の市Torinoichi000.jpg|thumb|{{ill|Tori-no-Ichi|de|Tori-no-Ichi|ja|酉の市|zh|Tori-no-Ichi|lt=Torinoichi}}の{{ill|Rake (tool)|af|Hark|an|Rasclo|ar|مدمة|az|Dırmıq|bar|Reechn|bat_smg|Grieblis|bcl|Kagkag|be|Граблі|be_x_old|Граблі|bg|Гребло (сечиво)|bn|রেক (সরঞ্জাম)|br|Rastell|ca|Rampí|ce|Кагтуха|cs|Hrábě|csb|Grable|cv|Кĕрепле|da|Rive|de|Rechen (Werkzeug)|el|Τσουγκράνα|eo|Rastilo|es|Rastrillo (herramienta)|et|Reha|eu|Eskuare|fa|شن‌کش|fi|Harava|fr|Râteau (outil)|frr|Riiw|fy|Riuwe (harke)|ga|Ráca (uirlis)|gl|Angazo|ha|Manjagara|he|מגרפה|hr|Grablje|hu|Gereblye|hy|Փոցխ|it|Rastrello|ja|熊手|kk|Тырнауыш|ko|갈퀴|ks|پَنٛجہٕ|kv|Нарман|ky|Тырмоо|la|Pecten (instrumentum)|lmo|Restell (arnes)|lt|Grėblys|lv|Grābeklis|mk|Гребло|nl|Hark|nn|Rive|no|Rive|oc|Rastèl|pa|ਕੰਘਾ (ਰੇਕ)|pam|Piruya|pl|Grabie (narzędzie)|pms|Rastel|pt|Ancinho|rsk|Граблї|ru|Грабли|scn|Rastreddu|sd|ڏانداري|sh|Grabulje|simple|Rake|sq|Rashqela|sr|Грабуље|sv|Kratta|szy|Kelup|th|คราด|tly|Dərəǧ|tr|Tırmık|uk|Граблі|ur|جرافہ (اوزار)|vi|Cào (dụng cụ)|vls|Rakel|wa|Rustea|wuu|耙|zea|Rieve|zh|耙|zh_yue|耙|qid=Q200822|lt=Kumade}}]]
'''Washi Shrine''' (Ootori jinja, Washi jinja) is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|en|Shinto shrine|qid=Q845945|lt=Shrine}}.

It is a shrine of the Ootori faith centered on {{ill|Ōtori taisha|abstract|Q705151|fr|Ōtori-taisha|ja|大鳥大社|my|အိုးတိုရိနတ်ကွန်း နန်းရင်း|zh|大鳥大社|qid=Q705151|lt=Ootori Taisha}}, and when read as “Ootori jinja” is considered to be related to {{ill|Ōtori Shrine|ja|大鳥神社 (曖昧さ回避)|qid=Q65258929|lt=Ootori Shrine}} and {{ill|Ōwashi Shrine (disambiguation)|de|Oowashi Schrein (Begriffsklärung)|ja|大鷲神社|zh|大鷲神社 (消歧义)|lt=Oowashi Shrine|lt_ja=大鷲神社|lt_de=Oowashi Schrein|lt_zh=大鷲神社|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/qq=draft|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q65258950}}, whereas when read as “Washi jinja” it is considered closely connected with {{ill|Washi-no-Miya Shrine (disambiguation)|ja|鷲宮神社 (曖昧さ回避)|qid=Q65293873|lt=Washi Miya Shrine}}, {{ill|Ame-no-Hiwashi Shrine (disambiguation)|de|Nichiwashi Schrein (Begriffsklärung)|ja|日鷲神社|zh|日鷲神社 (消歧义)|lt=Nichiwashi Shrine|lt_ja=日鷲神社|lt_de=Nichiwashi Schrein|lt_zh=日鷲神社|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/qq=draft|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q65270357}}, and {{ill|Ame-no-Hiwashi Shrine (disambiguation)|de|Tenjitsu Washi Schrein (Begriffsklärung)|ja|天日鷲神社|zh|天日鷲神社 (消歧义)|lt=Tenjitsu Washi Shrine|lt_ja=天日鷲神社|lt_de=Tenjitsu Washi Schrein|lt_zh=天日鷲神社|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/qq=draft|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 日鷲神社|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q65270357}}.

In terms of deity, besides the same {{ill|Ōtori taisha|abstract|Q705151|fr|Ōtori-taisha|ja|大鳥大社|my|အိုးတိုရိနတ်ကွန်း နန်းရင်း|zh|大鳥大社|qid=Q705151|lt=Ootori Taisha}} associated with {{ill|Yamato Takeru|en|Yamato Takeru|qid=Q461258|lt=Yamato Takeru}}, one may also observe {{ill|Otori-sama|ja|天日鷲神|ko|아메노히와시노카미|zh|天日鷲神|qid=Q10939697|lt=Otori-sama}}, {{ill|Ame-no-torifune|fr|Ame-no-torifune|ja|鳥之石楠船神|ko|도리노이와쿠스후네노카미|zh|鳥之石楠船神|qid=Q10731425|lt=Heavenly Bird Ship Deity}}, the same {{ill|Washinomiya Shrine|en|Washinomiya Shrine|qid=Q611108|lt=Washinomiya Shrine}}, as well as {{ill|Ame no Hohi|en|Ame no Hohi|qid=Q10940685|lt=Amenohohi}} and {{ill|Takehi-Nateru|fr|Takehi-Nateru|ja|建比良鳥命|zh|建比良鳥命|qid=Q11065428|lt=Wuyi Tori no Mikoto}}, as well as {{ill|Ōkuninushi|en|Ōkuninushi|qid=Q276944|qid=Q276944|lt=Okuninushi}}.

As a religious corporation, there are 76 {{ill|Washi Shrine (disambiguation)|de|Washi Shrine|ja|鷲神社|zh|Washi Shrine|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/qq=draft|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11676283}} establishments nationwide, 3 shrines including the name {{ill|Washi Shrine (disambiguation)|de|Washi Shrine (disambiguation)|ja|鷲神社|zh|Washi Shrine}}, and one each of {{ill|Washi Great Shrine|de|Washi Great Shrine|ja|鷲大神社|zh|Washi Great Shrine}} and {{ill|Washi Great Deity|de|Washi Great Deity|ja|鷲大神|zh|Washi Great Deity}}.

Also see: {{ill|Ōtori Shrine|ja|大鳥神社 (曖昧さ回避)|qid=Q65258929}}, {{ill|Ōwashi Shrine (disambiguation)|de|Oowashi Schrein (Begriffsklärung)|ja|大鷲神社|zh|大鷲神社 (消歧义)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/qq=draft|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q65258950}}, {{ill|Washi-no-Miya Shrine (disambiguation)|ja|鷲宮神社 (曖昧さ回避)|qid=Q65293873}}, and {{ill|Ame-no-Hiwashi Shrine (disambiguation)|de|Nichiwashi Schrein (Begriffsklärung)|ja|日鷲神社|zh|日鷲神社 (消歧义)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/qq=draft|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q65270357}}.
